milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the lapis_block pillar (centered at spawn-relative [5, 1, 5]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located the landmark. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the pillar.

Uses inventory_has because mining lime_stained_glass with the provided Silk Touch pickaxe causes the block to drop itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero lime_stained_glass, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining.
